_about: Recipe pages taken down because another page is the same dish. Each old URL answers a permanent (301) redirect to the page that stays: .htaccess on the live host, _redirects (written by the build) and vercel.json elsewhere. tools/retired-recipes-check.js (part of npm run check) holds the three to this list. Never reuse a slug listed here for a different dish.
